newsitem.title: USA: Lucent offering service to Visa-member banks.
newsitem.headline: Lucent offering service to Visa-member banks.

text.p: Lucent Technologies Inc said on Wednesday it has an agreement with Visa Interactive to offer banking-at-home services to Visa-member financial institutions.
Lucent said it is the first of a series of electronic banking services it plans to undertake.
Under the agreement, Lucent Technologies will provide an interactive voice-responsive system for remote banking and bill payments that is compatible with Visa Interactive's transaction standards.
Starting price for the software is $6,700 for small- and mid-sized banks with an Intuity Conversant 5.0 system already installed.
For banks that need both software and Intuity hardware, the price starts at $18,000, the company said.
Applications for large banks begin at $30,000.
Lucent is the producer of the Intuity Conversant 5.0 system.
